task: round 24 scan_hyp_portedpp: identify John Taylor's 'ported post-processing stage' (discussion 743929) among public code, check K2 equivalence, propose portable builds
summary: No public notebook can be copied as John Taylor's (JT) stage. His own post says 'public 0.953, OUR post-processing stage on top 0.957' (experiments/discussions/743929.md l.13) and 'settings go in the notebook after the deadline'. The kagglesdk best_public_score scan (~06:50Z) finds no public biohub notebook above 0.953: x138 plus three copies at 0.953, amanatar Geometric Fusion at 0.948, the rest <= 0.947. So E10 does not fire and nothing can be ported verbatim. I pulled 8 more public notebooks read-only (experiments/ext_*) and diffed their function sets and env knobs against x138. Every public post-processing stage that x138 lacks is either already inside K2 (division ADD = our DaughterNet insertion, cap 6 = 0.956) or in a family we have LB-read ourselves: weak-leaf prune (probe 40, 0.954, no UP), DeepCenter relax (probes 43/44, 0.954, flat), edge filter (probes 29/30), RE-AIM and pair-GBM (measured no-op / refuted), succskip, HOCT veto. amanatar's second-daughter repair is the closed I-047 post-hoc-division family with a relaxed DeepCenter, which our flat probe 43/44 reads already price. One public class fits JT's fingerprint and is not yet proven on our base: yuki0731's CC0 coord-inject. Its own manifest says 'Runtime coordinate injection for rock0926 public notebook', i.e. it was built to be ported. It is node-neutral, and a placement gain of +0.004 is plausible (the V1284 head gave +0.006-0.007 inside the x138 lineage). Our copy is exp79a = probe 48, still PENDING. The one actionable build is therefore exp87a = exp85a (probe 50: JT's two knobs on cap 6) + coordinject. It is JT's hypothesised full recipe on our insertion base. Build it and run its dummy now; give it a slot only if probe 48 reads >= 0.957 and probe 50 reads >= 0.956. The ILP-fork-restore patch (the one mechanism that would give JT's ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT step a direct channel) and amanatar's V6 knob bundle carry no public evidence and stay below the bar. Honest bottom line: no new ported stage reaches R8; CI is the only live candidate, and it is already in flight.

findings.what: ILP-fork restore (--patch ilpfork). This is the only mechanism that would give JT's ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT step a DIRECT output channel on an x138 base. After the tail, for each raw ILP fork p -> {c1, c2} where the final graph kept p -> c1 only and c2 survives with in-degree 0 at t+1, re-add p -> c2 under the safe-division geometry (SAFE_DIV_MAX_UM 9, SISTER_MAX 14, DeepCenter accept at 0.25), capped at 6 per video. At ILP 0.4 the ILP makes fewer, more precise forks (old exp12: 0.6 gave 24 TP / 103 FP vs 36 / 205 at 1.2). Our base has no such channel: x138 'if motion_edges: stats["motion_relink_replaced_raw_edges"] = len(edges); edges = motion_edges', and the ILP edge keys enter the relink only via learned_edge_probs (a <= 1 um bonus). That is why exp85b (ILP 0.4 alone) moved only +49 nodes / +3 forks.
